create.name: Kamini Desai
create.bio:
Kamini Desai grew up inside the yoga tradition as the daughter of Yogi Amrit Desai, who founded the original Kripalu ashram, and she trained at Kripalu herself before studying anthropology and psychology at Smith College and La Salle University. She later ran education at the Amrit Yoga Institute and directed wellness at an executive retreat centre. In 2012 she was given the title Yogeshwari in recognition of her yogic study, and she teaches in English, Dutch and French.

Her central subject is yoga nidra, the guided practice of resting in deep awareness between waking and sleep. She co-founded the I AM Yoga Nidra method and directs I AM Education, which offers self-paced and in-person trainings built around five tools of the practice and the setting of a heartfelt intention, or sankalpa. Alongside the trainings she gives live masterclasses on yogic philosophy, from the gunas and Samkhya to the symbolism of Shakti, Kali and Durga, each closing with a guided nidra. Her books are a guide, Yoga Nidra: The Art of Transformational Sleep, plus a memoir, Life Lessons, Love Lessons, and her recorded practices reach a wide audience through two apps. Her in-person programmes take her to Europe, including Prague and an eco-village in Iceland, and to Kripalu in Massachusetts.

books.title: Life Lessons Love Lessons: A Guru's Daughter Discovers Knowledge Is Only Half the Journey
books.author: Kamini Desai
books.description: A memoir of growing up as a yoga master's daughter and of what her own relationships taught her. Told with humour, it shows how yogic principles can be lived in everyday dealings with yourself and others.

courses.title: Yoga Nidra Retreat: Deep Rest, Reflection, and Renewal
courses.description: A five-night stay at Kripalu that treats yoga nidra as a route into deeper consciousness as well as rest. Sessions cover prana, meditative yoga and breath, ojas, the third eye, intention and karma, with time left for quiet reflection.

courses.title: I AM Yoga Nidra Training in Prague (Immersion and Certification)
courses.description: An in-person facilitator training at Maitrea in central Prague, taught in English with Czech interpretation. The immersion module runs in December 2026 and the certification module from 18 to 21 March 2027.

courses.title: Yoga Nidra I: Self-Paced Immersion Training
courses.description: The first stage of her yoga nidra curriculum, studied at your own pace. It covers the yogic principles behind the practice and her five-tool method, and can lead on to the certification level.

courses.title: 2026 New Yoga Nidra Masterclass Bundle
courses.description: Three recorded masterclasses to keep: the gunas and leshyas, the symbolism of the yogic deities, and Shakti, Kali and Durga as forces of inner change. Each mixes philosophy with a guided nidra.

courses.title: Yoga Nidra and Kundalini Shakti
courses.description: A recorded masterclass introducing Kundalini Shakti and how the I AM approach works with it safely as part of spiritual growth. A lecture is followed by a guided practice.

courses.title: Yoga Nidra & the Wisdom of Sāṃkhya
courses.description: A recorded masterclass on Samkhya philosophy and how its ideas can be felt directly through witnessing and drawing the senses inward in yoga nidra.

courses.title: The Power of 3rd Eye - On Demand
courses.description: An on-demand class on what the third eye is and the part it plays in spiritual practice, ending with a guided yoga nidra. Access lasts 90 days.

courses.title: I AM Being Premium App
courses.description: Her subscription app of guided yoga nidra recordings, short mindful pauses, teachings and practices for children, with new content added over time. A simpler one-off app with seven practices is also available.
courses.price: $5.99 USD per month or $24.99 USD per year

flags: Her best-known book, Yoga Nidra: The Art of Transformational Sleep (ASIN 0940676397), is left out: its Amazon and site blurb says it shows how to neutralise insomnia, depression, anxiety, trauma and addictions. It is named in the bio as her book; a human may decide whether the book itself can be listed.
Email info@iameducation.org is the published inbox of I AM Education, her school (contact page and footer), not a personal address.

Her site leans heavily on yoga therapy and therapeutic applications of yoga nidra (I AM Yoga Therapy, Yoga Nidra II/III with condition lists). Those items are left out; what remains is yoga nidra as rest and spiritual practice. The yoga nidra and yogic philosophy work is clearly her main teaching, so not skipped.
Yoga Nidra I product page mentions 'healing' generically (no condition named); kept as borderline.

Possible editorial-stature case for the owner: co-founder of I AM Yoga Nidra (described as one of five major yoga nidra schools), daughter and lineage holder of Yogi Amrit Desai, Kripalu's founder. Counts give local_hero; no tier_override set.
Her father Amrit Desai left Kripalu in 1994 after a misconduct scandal; the bio mentions him only as the founder of the original ashram. A human may prefer to drop the reference.
